# hetznerrobot_servers (Data Source)

Lists every dedicated server of the account. The listing carries no feature flags — read `hetznerrobot_server` for those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_servers" "all" {}

output "server_numbers" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_servers.all.servers[*].server_number
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) The servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the server is cancelled.
- `dc` (String) Data center.
- `ips` (List of String) Single IP addresses assigned to the server.
- `paid_until` (String) Paid-until date.
- `product` (String) Product name.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IPv4 address; null on an IPv6-only server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net address.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the server.
- `server_number` (Number) Server number.
- `status` (String) `ready` or `in process`.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets assigned to the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers--subnets))
- `traffic` (String) Free traffic quota; `unlimited` for unlimited traffic.

<a id="nestedatt--servers--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers.subnets`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Net address.
- `mask` (String) Prefix length.
